column7: POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/roles answered a role beyond the actor's grant ceiling (a typed core.ErrPermissionDenied) with the 500 'Failed to assign role to group'; a refusal was reported as a server fault. It is a 403 now, permanent and time-bound, with no grant row written. PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/roles already answered 403 (#3840); TestUpdateUserRolesHTTP_RoleBeyondGrantCeiling_Forbidden pins it at handler level.
